rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides read-only access to the AT Protocol decentralized network, abstracting away Bluesky-specific APIs to work with any Personal Data Server (PDS). Supports handle resolution, repository metadata retrieval, record listing and fetching, blob retrieval with inline image content, and full-text search for posts and users. Built in Rust with the rmcp SDK and requires no authentication for public data access.
